title: Control-aware training of physical neural networks for closed-loop regulation: research software
description: Reproducible research software, frozen evaluation configurations, source data and integrity records accompanying the manuscript 'Control-aware training of physical neural networks for closed-loop regulation'. Version 1.1.0 adds the canonical Cart-Pole E-060C1 task-generalization study, finite-horizon first-divergence analysis and associated source-data/integrity records while retaining the complete prior confirmatory and negative-result record.
